card.name: Commas in inactive ingredient lists
card.fires_on: Mostly the comma after an excipient name in a list of inactive ingredients, such as after cellulose, citric acid or lactose. Also fires on a few list-style linking words and opening quotes.

modes.label: Commas in excipient lists
modes.description: The comma after one inactive ingredient, just before the next one is named.

modes.label: Other list openers
modes.description: An opening quote or a linking word such as 'as' or 'and' inside an enumerated list of examples.
